* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance

We are looking for a hands-on Consultant/ Senior Consultant to lead Integrations for a portfolio of clients (US Shift)

Sr. Consultant will lead a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development — owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. As an SAP Partner specializing in SAP BRIM, Acuiti Labs delivers business technology solutions and digital transformation on SAP S/4HANA and cloud applications such as Subscription Billing, CPQ, and Entitlement Management.

Our expertise supports subscription and consumption-based Target Operating Models across industries: Mobility-as-a-Service, Tourism-as-a-Service, Ports-as-a-Service, Postal-as-a-Service, Telco-as-a-Service, and Software-as-a-Service.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Associate Lead – Talent Acquisition to independently manage end-to end recruitment, primarily for our India operations, while supporting international hiring requirements. The ideal candidate will have strong in-house recruitment experience, proven expertise in SAP S/4HANA hiring, and hands-on experience managing campus recruitment.

The role also requires effective use of AI-powered recruitment tools, ATS platforms and automation to improve hiring efficiency. The candidate should be comfortable working independently with minimal supervision and supporting other HR activities as required.

* Independently manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, negotiations, offers and onboarding.

* Understanding of compensation benchmarks and hiring practices in the US, UK and Canada.

**TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER**

**We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**

**Position Snapshot:**

  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**

As a Test Automation Specialist, you will be working on the Business Applications powering the Nespresso Retail and Trade network, as well as Customer Relations Centers. You will work in an employee-facing applications context, supporting large volumes of internal users and transactions, while being part of a large development organization with a direct impact on the business.

As a central part of the software engineering community, you will bring deep technical expertise and knowledge to the product team, being part of the technical reference team for Nespresso web applications and focusing on quality strategy and automation practices. You will guide and promote the optimal use of processes and technology to support the cost-effective delivery of business requirements within your area of expertise.

As the Automation Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the correct execution of the QA and testing strategy across the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains, ensuring the quality and reliability of our business applications, with a strong focus on driving the test automation framework. You will work closely with cross-functional delivery teams to ensure the adoption of QA and testing practices, and with Release and DevOps teams to streamline the release cycle and improve the overall quality of our web applications. You will also make a strong contribution to the QA strategy through a community of practice in collaboration with the QA Office.

**In This Role, You Will:**

  

* Apply the test automation framework and infrastructure, ensuring its reliability and scalability.
* Contribute to the creation of a growing full test automation library.
* Participate in defining and keeping the QA and testing strategy for our Business Applications up to date.
* Participate in defining and keeping the test automation strategy and practices for Nespresso up to date, using industry-standard tools and frameworks to ensure maximum test coverage and efficiency.
* Ensure that cross-functional delivery teams in the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains follow the defined guidelines and deliver according to the quality standards of Nespresso release cycles.
* Mentor and guide QA engineers and testers, providing technical expertise and support in test automation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, DevOps, and Release Engineers to continuously improve the overall quality and efficiency of the testing process. Actively participate in the QA community of practice alongside QA Leads and the Nespresso QA Office.

**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of professional experience.
* Proven experience as an Automation Test Engineer or in a similar role, specifically in web application testing.
* Strong knowledge of API testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks.
* Proven experience using Gherkin and Xray.
* Proficiency in using test automation tools and frameworks, such as Playwright.
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English with people at different levels of the organization.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

  

* Passion for technology, test automation, and DevOps, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical populations in a large organization.
* Experience working in a global environment and collaborating with virtual teams.

**We Offer You:**

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* **Stakeholder Interview:** Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* **Leadership & HRBP Interaction:** Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

**About Nespresso:**

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.

In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*

People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together

Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

description:
**Talent Partner**

Qrata | Remote – United States | Full-Time

*Experience: 2–4 Years | Shift: U.S. Business Hours 6pm-3am (EST / CST / PST)*

**About the Role**

At Qrata, we believe hiring should be built on clarity, context, and trusted partnerships—not just résumés. As a Talent Recruiter on our U.S. team, you will go beyond sourcing profiles to become a strategic advisor to both clients and candidates. You’ll capture deep role insights to craft the perfect Role DNA, refine AI-generated scorecards to align with client requirements, and guide candidates through every step of the hiring journey.

This is a fully remote position supporting U.S.-based clients. You will work standard U.S. business hours and collaborate closely with hiring managers, candidates, and internal teams across U.S. time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Role Discovery & Research**

* Partner with U.S. hiring managers to understand business goals, team dynamics, and role-specific success metrics.

* Deep-dive into client needs, industry context, and organizational challenges to define what great talent looks like for each role.

* Translate insights into tailored Role DNA profiles and refine AI-generated scorecards to reflect nuanced hiring requirements.

**Advisory Screening & Candidate Engagement**

* Conduct thoughtful phone and video pre-screens assessing skills, motivations, and cultural fit for U.S.-based roles.

* Score candidates accurately against Role DNA, providing clients with clear, data-backed hiring recommendations.

* Build strong rapport with candidates, guide them through the interview process, align expectations, and support smooth onboarding.

**Client Partnership**

* Act as a trusted recruiting advisor—simplify hiring decisions, eliminate decision fatigue, and deliver proactive updates.

* Leverage Qrata’s analytics platform to share weekly hiring summaries and market insights that keep clients confident and informed.

* Develop long-term client relationships that drive repeat engagement and referrals.

**Hiring Excellence & Execution**

* Manage full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, supporting offer negotiations, reference checks, and onboarding.

* Maintain accurate candidate pipelines and ATS records; meet weekly and monthly hiring SLAs.

* Stay current on U.S. labor market trends, compensation benchmarks, and recruiting best practices.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree a plus.

* 2–4 years of full-cycle recruiting or talent acquisition experience supporting U.S.-based clients or roles (agency, RPO, or in-house).

* Hands-on experience sourcing and engaging U.S.-based candidates in tech, SaaS, or professional services preferred.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable in strategic conversations with U.S. hiring managers and senior stakeholders.

* Strong sourcing skills—proficient with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and modern ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.).

* Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously in a remote environment.

* Solid business acumen to understand roles, compensation norms, and organizational priorities in the U.S. market.

* Self-starter who thrives with autonomy, takes ownership of outcomes, and communicates proactively.

**U.S. Staffing & Contract / Tax Knowledge**

A strong understanding of U.S. staffing models, worker classifications, and tax terms is essential for this role. Candidates must be familiar with the following:

**Worker Classification & Employment Types**

* W-2 (Full-Time Employee) – Understand W-2 employment where the employer withholds federal/state income tax, Social Security, and Medicare (FICA). Know the difference between direct-hire W-2 and W-2 through a staffing agency.

* 1099 / Independent Contractor – Ability to explain 1099 contractor arrangements, self-employment tax obligations, and IRS criteria that distinguish contractors from employees (behavioral control, financial control, type of relationship).

* Corp-to-Corp (C2C) – Understand C2C engagements where a vendor’s corporation invoices the client company directly. Know how to identify legitimate C2C setups vs. misclassification risks.

**Tax Terms & Work Authorization**

* Tax Terms – Comfortable discussing tax terms with candidates: W-2 with benefits, W-2 without benefits, 1099, C2C, and hybrid models. Able to explain all-inclusive vs. plus-expenses billing rates.

* Work Authorization – Familiar with U.S. work authorization statuses: U.S. Citizen, Green Card (GC/PR), H-1B, H-4 EAD, OPT/STEM OPT, TN, L-1, E-3, and CPT. Able to screen candidates accurately and communicate sponsorship availability.

* H-1B Sponsorship – Basic understanding of the H-1B cap, lottery process, transfer vs. new filing, and the difference between cap-exempt and cap-subject employers.

* Right-to-Work (RTW) Verification – Knowledge of I-9 compliance requirements and E-Verify processes.

**Contract & Engagement Models**

* Contract / Contract-to-Hire (C2H) – Understand the structure of contract engagements, conversion clauses, and temp-to-perm arrangements. Able to communicate contract durations, extensions, and conversion timelines to candidates.

* Bill Rate vs. Pay Rate – Ability to calculate and discuss bill rates, pay rates, mark-ups, and gross margins in a staffing context.

* SOW vs. Staff Augmentation – Differentiate between Statement of Work (SOW) engagements and traditional staff augmentation, and understand when each model applies.

* Benefits & Compliance – Awareness of ACA (Affordable Care Act) compliance thresholds, benefits eligibility for contract workers, and state-specific payroll regulations (e.g., California, New York).

**Work Setup**

* 100% Remote – Work from anywhere in the United States.

* U.S. Shift Hours – Availability required during standard U.S. business hours (Eastern, Central, or Pacific time zones).

* Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace required.

**Our Values**

At Qrata, our values are not just words on a wall—they shape how we show up for clients and candidates every day:

* Radical Transparency – Communicate openly and honestly with teammates, clients, and candidates.

* Growth Mindset – Experiment, adapt, and continuously sharpen your craft.

* Team Accountability – Solve problems proactively and rally around collective success.

* Selflessness – Put Qrata’s mission and client outcomes above individual wins.

* Grit – Show persistence, resilience, and genuine care in every search you run.

*Qrata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

Pay: ₹650,000.00 - ₹780,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
* Work from home

**Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants**
===============================================

**Position:** Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** IT Staffing & Professional Services  
**Location:** Remote / Hybrid

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced and highly professional **Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants** to serve as the **primary point of contact for our W2 consultant workforce**.

This position will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle and ensuring that their questions, concerns, and requests are addressed promptly and professionally.

The ideal candidate will combine strong **employee-relations expertise, communication skills, IT staffing knowledge, and operational judgment**. This individual should be approachable and responsive while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and appropriate boundaries when handling sensitive employee matters.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Employee & Consultant Relations**

* Serve as the **primary point of contact for W2 consultants** regarding employment-related questions, concerns, and requests.
* Establish and maintain professional, trusted relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle.
* Provide timely communication and appropriate follow-up on consultant inquiries and concerns.
* Listen to employee concerns, understand the underlying issue, and coordinate with the appropriate internal stakeholders to achieve resolution.
* Handle sensitive and escalated matters with discretion, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Maintain accurate records of employee concerns, communications, actions taken, and resolutions.

### **Payroll & Employment Support**

* Coordinate with Payroll and HR regarding questions related to **salary, payroll processing, timesheets, deductions, reimbursements, benefits, and employment documentation**.
* Assist consultants in understanding company processes and requirements.
* Monitor outstanding payroll or employment-related issues and ensure appropriate follow-up through resolution.
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate management or functional team.

### **Immigration Coordination**

* Serve as the communication liaison between consultants and the organization's **Immigration/Legal team**.
* Coordinate requests and documentation related to **H-1B transfers, extensions, amendments, OPT/EAD, and other employment authorization matters**.
* Ensure consultants receive timely updates regarding the status of immigration-related requests.
* Facilitate communication and follow-up without providing independent legal or immigration advice.

### **Marketing, Projects & Consultant Support**

* Coordinate with Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, and Account Management regarding consultant **marketing status, job opportunities, submissions, interviews, project assignments, and placement activities**.
* Ensure consultants receive appropriate updates regarding their project or marketing status.
* Assist consultants during onboarding, project transitions, client interviews, assignments, and offboarding.
* Identify and escalate issues that may impact consultant engagement, retention, or project continuity.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner effectively with **HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, Sales, Account Management, and senior management**.
* Take ownership of consultant issues and ensure they are routed to the appropriate department.
* Maintain visibility into open issues and proactively follow up until resolution.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to policies, processes, and communication.
* Develop and maintain effective communication processes between consultants and internal departments.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field** preferred.
* **3–7+ years of experience** in Employee Relations, HR Operations, Consultant Relations, IT Staffing, Workforce Management, or a related field.
* Previous experience supporting **W2 IT consultants** within a U.S. staffing or consulting organization is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the U.S. IT staffing and consulting environment.
* Familiarity with **H-1B, H-1B transfers, OPT/EAD, and employment authorization processes**.
* Experience coordinating with Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, HR, and staffing operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive employee concerns with professionalism and discretion.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* **Employee & Consultant Relationship Management**
* **Conflict Resolution & Issue Management**
* **Cross-Functional Coordination**
* **Professional Communication**
* **Problem Solving & Ownership**
* **Confidentiality & Professional Judgment**
* **U.S. Staffing Operations**
* **Payroll & Employment Processes**
* **Immigration Coordination**
* **Consultant Engagement & Retention**

**Performance Expectations**
----------------------------

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to provide W2 consultants with a **consistent, responsive, and professional employee experience**.

The Employee Relations Manager is expected to:

* Establish strong relationships and trust with the consultant workforce.
* Respond to consultant inquiries in a timely manner.
* Ensure issues are appropriately assigned, tracked, and resolved.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication throughout the resolution process.
* Minimize recurring consultant concerns through proactive communication and process improvement.
* Strengthen collaboration between consultants and internal departments.
* Support overall consultant engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

### **The Role in One Sentence**

**The Employee Relations Manager will serve as the central point of contact and advocate for our W2 consultants, coordinating across HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing, and Management to ensure their employment-related needs are addressed professionally and efficiently.**

The role suits someone who enjoys a fast pace, takes ownership of closures, and treats every hire as a reflection of the company's brand.

* Coordinate technical tests or assignments where applicable.
* Shortlist and share qualified profiles with hiring managers within agreed turnaround times.

* Schedule and coordinate interview rounds with panels and candidates.
* Brief interviewers and candidates ahead of each round.
* Collect structured feedback promptly and keep candidates informed of their status at each stage.

* Draft and issue offer letters and appointment letters using approved templates, accurately covering designation, CTC breakup, joining date, probation, notice period and other key terms.

* Obtain internal approvals before release, and maintain version control and records of all offers issued.
* Prepare related letters as needed, such as revised offers, offer extensions and offer withdrawals.
* Manage offer roll-out and acceptance, and handle counter-offers.

6. Pre-Joining & Onboarding

* Stay in regular contact with selected candidates during the notice period to minimize dropouts.
* Coordinate background and reference verification.

7. Hiring Data & Reporting

* Maintain the recruitment tracker with accurate, up-to-date candidate data.
* Publish weekly and monthly MIS on open positions, pipeline status, closures and dropouts.
* Ensure the hiring process follows company policy and maintain proper documentation.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, a results-oriented approach, leadership abilities, negotiation skills, adaptability and industry awareness, and a solid background in recruitment strategy.

**Company Culture:** We are committed to maintaining a strong ethical foundation built on professionalism, transparency, and mutual respect. * Provident Fund
